negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 19608718 - the paediatric trial did not show benefit.

PMID 27483065 (VANISH) did not meet its primary kidney-failure-free-days endpoint; VASST (PMID 18305265) did not show a mortality difference overall. Vasopressin's story is a sequence of neutral primary endpoints with subgroup signals - state that plainly.
PMIDs 23786655 and 29801010 carry the ischaemia and atrial fibrillation harms.
cautions: This is an intravenous critical-care drug. The no-dosing and no-medical-advice bans are the binding constraint on this page; describe trial designs and outcomes without any administration guidance.
Selepressin (PMID 28807037 in the screened set) is a selective V1a agonist, a DIFFERENT compound - do not fold its results into vasopressin.
Terlipressin and desmopressin are analogues, not vasopressin. Keep the evidence bases separate.
